No corroborating account-takeover chain (no MFA abuse, inbox rules, credential changes, or downstream access), so the threshold for contain is not met. The signal is not explained away, so it is not benign, and there is no conflicting/insufficient evidence requiring human escalation. It is a weak unexplained signal warranting monitoring.
